cat > /tmp/core_ctx/Dockerfile <<'EOF'
# builder stage
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm AS builder

WORKDIR /build

COPY pyproject.toml README.md ./
COPY src/ ./src/
COPY data-structures/ ./data-structures/

RUN pip wheel --no-deps --no-cache-dir -w /tmp/local-wheels/ ./data-structures/ && \
    pip wheel --no-cache-dir --no-input --find-links /tmp/local-wheels/ --wheel-dir /wheels .

# final stage
FROM prefecthq/prefect:3.7.4-python3.12 AS final

USER root

WORKDIR /wheels
COPY --from=builder /wheels .

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --no-index --find-links=. ./*.whl && \
    rm -rf /wheels

WORKDIR /app

COPY ./src/demospipes_core/ ./demospipes_core/

RUN useradd --system --no-create-home --uid 1000 appuser
USER appuser
EOF
cd /tmp/core_ctx && DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 nohup docker build -t demospipes-base-executors:v1.24.195-main-8a31fa9 . > /tmp/build_core2.log 2>&1 & echo started; sleep 90; tail -15 /tmp/build_core2.log
